mapper.select: SELECT TRANSACTION_NO AS transaction_no, FROM_ACCOUNT_NUMBER AS from_account_number, TO_ACCOUNT_NUMBER AS to_account_number, AMOUNT AS amount, TRANSACTION_TYPE AS transaction_type, BALANCE_AFTER AS balance_after, MEMO AS memo, COUNTERPARTY_NAME AS counterparty_name, TRANSACTION_AT AS transaction_at FROM tb_account_transaction WHERE FROM_ACCOUNT_NUMBER = #{accountNo} OR TO_ACCOUNT_NUMBER = #{accountNo} ORDER BY TRANSACTION_AT DESC
